library(cmdstanr)

### NSB with Regression Model

```{r}

nsb_baseline_model <- cmdstan_model("stan/core_01_static_nsb_pe_optimised.stan")
nsb_baseline_model

```

## Prep Data for STAN

Data needs to be in a list format with motifs.

For the event-level Stan models, `y` is a plain integer vector: one motif event
per entry, coded from `1` to `K`. For 3-motifs, `K = 6`.

```{R}
make_data_bundle_single_site <- function(y , m=3){
  Z <- ordinal_pattern_time_series(y, m)+1 # Vector of motifs, from 1
  Z <- Z[!is.na(Z)]
  list(N = length(Z),
       K = as.integer(factorial(m)),
       y = as.integer(Z),
       prior_only = 0)
}
```


# Data

## Underlying Time Series Data

### High and low PE values

Single very long time series for start and end parameters, from which to calculate 'true' PE

```{r}
AR2 = -1.1
sim_LOWPE_long <- simulate_feedback_sites(n_site = 2,n_year = 10000,
                                          delayed_feedback = AR2,
                                          sd_start = 0.05, sd_end = 0.05)

sim_HIGHPE_long <- simulate_feedback_sites(n_site = 2,n_year = 10000,
                                           delayed_feedback = AR2,
                                           sd_start = 0.3, sd_end = 0.3)

## Just for coding ease and using just one function, making from 2 sites, then will drop 1
Long_singlesite_LOWPE <- sim_LOWPE_long$abundance_matrix[,1]
Long_singlesite_HIGHPE <- sim_HIGHPE_long$abundance_matrix[,1]
```

### 'True' (long sample) PE

```{r}
## Compare long series of fixed noise:
True_LowPE<- permutation_entropy(ordinal_pattern_distribution(Long_singlesite_LOWPE, 3))
True_HighPE<- permutation_entropy(ordinal_pattern_distribution(Long_singlesite_HIGHPE,3))

```

## Prior Only Model

Checking that the prior is genuinely uninformative, and that the prior-only posterior PE spans full 0:1 range. 

```{r}
pp<- make_data_bundle_single_site(Long_singlesite_LOWPE)
pp$prior_only <- 1

prior_only_fit <- nsb_baseline_model$sample(data = pp,
                                            chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4,
                                            adapt_delta = 0.95, refresh = 0)

prior_only_fit 
```

# Repeat fitting to short datasets

## Chopping data into short (32 observation) time series:

```{r}
batch_function <- function(batch, length =50, ts){
  if( length(ts)< batch*length){stop('time series too short')}
  start<- 1+((batch-1)*length)
  end<- batch*length
  return(ts[ start:end   ])
}

LowPE_TS_list_short <- map(1:100,   batch_function , ts = Long_singlesite_LOWPE, length = 32)
HighPE_TS_list_short <- map(1:100,   batch_function , ts = Long_singlesite_HIGHPE, length = 32)

```


## Fit NSB Baseline Model across list


```{r}
fit_model_baseline <-  function(ts ){
  xx<- make_data_bundle_single_site(ts)
  fit <- nsb_baseline_model$sample(data = xx,
                                   chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4,
                                   adapt_delta = 0.95, refresh = 0)
  df <- fit$summary(variables = c('pe_nsb', 'pe_plugin'))
  return(df)
}
```



## Fit NSB Baseline Model acros list

Takes several minutes to run

```{r eval=FALSE}
LowPE_modelfits_short<- map_df(LowPE_TS_list_short,fit_model_baseline)
HighPE_modelfits_short<- map_df(HighPE_TS_list_short,fit_model_baseline)

write_csv( LowPE_modelfits_short, file = 'model fits/LowPE_modelfits_short32.csv')
write_csv( HighPE_modelfits_short,file = 'model fits/HighPE_modelfits_short32.csv')
```

```{R}
LowPE_modelfits_short <- read_csv(file = 'model fits/LowPE_modelfits_short32.csv')
HighPE_modelfits_short<- read_csv(file = 'model fits/HighPE_modelfits_short32.csv')
```

### Measure Naive PE for each short series

```{r}
PE3_ts <- function(ts ){ permutation_entropy(ordinal_pattern_distribution(ts, 3))   }

naive_lowPE_measures_short<- map_dbl(LowPE_TS_list_short,PE3_ts )
naive_highPE_measures_short<-map_dbl(HighPE_TS_list_short,PE3_ts )
```

## Plotting out posterior of PE with NSB estimator, compared to naive and true PE.  

### Low PE dataset
```{R}
## ranks
LowPE_modelfits_short  %>%
  filter( variable == 'pe_plugin') %>%
  mutate( rank =  rank(mean, ties.method = 'first')) %>%
  select(Obs_Val = mean, rank)-> Low_Ranks_short


## Average
LowPE_modelfits_short  %>%
  filter( variable == 'pe_nsb') %>%
  summarise( Overall_Mean = mean( mean) , 
             Overall_q5 = mean( q5) , 
             Overall_q95 = mean( q95), 
             x = 'Average')%>%
  ggplot(aes( y =Overall_Mean, x = x))+
  geom_errorbar(aes( ymin = Overall_q5, ymax = Overall_q95),
                col = 'grey80')+
  geom_point()+
  geom_point(y = mean(Low_Ranks_short$Obs_Val), col = 'red')+
  geom_hline(yintercept = True_LowPE, col = '#0072B2' )+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.7, 1))+
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y= element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y= element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  xlab( ' \n ') -> Low_pe_av

## Plot
LowPE_modelfits_short  %>%
  filter( variable == 'pe_nsb') %>%
  bind_cols( Low_Ranks_short) %>%
  ggplot(aes( y =mean, x = rank))+
  geom_errorbar(aes( ymin = q5, ymax = q95), col = 'grey80')+
  geom_point()+
  geom_point(aes(y = Obs_Val), col = 'red')+
  geom_hline(yintercept = True_LowPE, col = '#0072B2' )+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.7, 1))+
  xlab( 'Sample')+
  ylab('Permutation Entropy') -> Short_LowPE_Fig

## Combine
plot_grid(Short_LowPE_Fig,
          Low_pe_av,
          rel_widths = c(10,1) )

```

### Creating joint figure

```{r}

## Legend Constructor
df <- data.frame( x = 1, y = 1,grp = c("NSB-Model Posterior Mean", "Naive Observation", '"True"'))
legend <- get_legend(ggplot(df, aes(x, y, colour = grp)) +
                       geom_point(data = subset(df, grp != '"True"'), size = 3) +
                       geom_line(data = subset(df, grp == '"True"'),
                                 aes(group = grp), linewidth = 1) +
                       scale_colour_manual(values = c( "NSB-Model Posterior Mean" = "black",
                                                       "Naive Observation" = "red",
                                                       '"True"' = "#0072B2"),
                                           name = NULL ) +
                       guides( colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, 
                                                     override.aes = list(alpha = 1)) ) +
                       theme_void() +
                       theme(legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
  legend.key.size = unit(10, "pt")))


Panela <- plot_grid(Short_LowPE_Fig,
                    Low_pe_av,align = 'h',
                    rel_widths = c(10,1) )

Panelb <-  plot_grid(Short_HighPE_Fig, 
                     High_pe_av,align = 'h',
                     rel_widths = c(10,1) )

main_plots <- plot_grid( Panela, Panelb,
                         labels = c("a) ", "b)"),scale = 0.95,
                         nrow = 1,rel_widths = c(1, 1))

demo1plot <- plot_grid(main_plots,legend,
                       ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.12))

demo1plot

saveRDS(demo1plot, "MS_figs/ggplot objects/demo1plot.rds")
ggsave(demo1plot, filename = 'MS_figs/ggplot objects/demo1plot.png', width = 9, height =3  )

```

### Distribution of diferences to truth

Mean of posterior distribution across the 100 draws is much better centered around the truth

```{r}
LowPE_modelfits_short  %>%
  filter( variable == 'pe_nsb') %>%
  bind_cols(Low_Ranks_short) %>%
  mutate( True_PE=True_LowPE, 
          Posterior_PEDiff = mean  - True_PE,
          Obs_PEDiff = Obs_Val    - True_PE) %>%
  select( rank , Posterior_PEDiff, Obs_PEDiff  ) %>%
  pivot_longer( ends_with('PEDiff')) %>%
  ggplot(aes( value, fill = name))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_vline( xintercept = 0)+
  theme_classic()


HighPE_modelfits_short  %>%
  filter( variable == 'pe_nsb') %>%
  bind_cols( High_Ranks_short) %>%
  mutate( True_PE=True_HighPE, 
          Posterior_PEDiff = mean  - True_PE,
          Obs_PEDiff = Obs_Val    - True_PE) %>%
  select( rank , Posterior_PEDiff, Obs_PEDiff  ) %>%
  pivot_longer( ends_with('PEDiff')) %>%
  ggplot(aes( value, fill = name))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_vline( xintercept = 0)+
  theme_classic()


```
